title: Limited Slots
description: Datapack that gradually removes your slots
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/627278d5927916cb59570fc4f128cd798badf4ad.png)

# Was inspired by [Yahimouse](https://www.youtube.com/@YahiamiceLIVE)'s [video](https://youtu.be/42_2ox253G8)
**This datapack was created for my video to play with friends. Found bug / order datapack / other - [Discord](https://discord.gg/dCWyMsE94D).**

**This datapack was intended to challange players to play without some slots.**

![Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aec6e7cad83b9f027b87bf9bb38fee0482f24461.png)

# Usage explanation:
After the command is launched, a 5-minute timer will begin, which will be repeated indefinitely. When the timer runs out, each player will have a random slot locked, and the slot number will also be displayed in the center of the screen.
- Start 5 minute timer to roll - **/function limitedslots:start**
- Stop timer - **/function limitedslots:stop**
- Unlock all slots - **/function limitedslots:reset_slots**
- Instant lock random slot - **/function limitedslots:roll**
